description: This file defines the 'Project' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, including its properties, relationships (such as customer association and project admins), and methods for accessing and modifying its data. It is mapped to a database table 'ohrm_project' using Doctrine ORM annotations.

classes.name: Project
classes.description: Entity class representing a project, including properties like id, customer, name, description, deletion status, and project administrators, with associated getter and setter methods.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Associates a Customer entity with this project.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the project is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Marks the project as deleted or active.

methods.name: getProjectAdmins
methods.description: Returns the list of project administrators.
